findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure directory creation
 * @description Creating directories with insecure permissions (e.g. 0o777) can allow unauthorized access.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-dir-creation
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-276
 *       external/cwe/cwe-732
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["mkdir", "makedirs"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getMember("mkdir").getACall()
  )
  and
  (
    exists(DataFlow::Node modeArg |
      modeArg = call.getArgByName("mode") or
      modeArg = call.getArg(1) // mkdir(path, mode)
      |
      // Check if mode is 0o777 or similar insecure value
      // This is a heuristic; often mode is omitted (default 0o777 minus umask)
      // or explicitly set.
      exists(int val | val = modeArg.asExpr().(IntegerLiteral).getValue() |
        val = 511 // 0o777
      )
    )
  )
select call, "Directory creation with potentially insecure permissions."
findings.hypothesis: The package might create directories with insecure permissions (e.g., world-writable).
